reviewer_role: Judge E — Hackathon Organizer & Technical Evaluator

strengths.claim: Directly addresses core hackathon focus: voice fluidity and technical depth
strengths.evidence: Engineered custom AudioWorklet continuous PCM player resolving real-world network jitter gaps without hand-waving or fake metrics

strengths.claim: Immediate, tangible ADHD utility within 30 seconds
strengths.evidence: A user can open the app, speak a daunting task, receive a single micro-step, start a timer, and begin within 30 seconds

strengths.claim: Exceptional testing rigor and technical honesty
strengths.evidence: 661 unit tests, 97 Playwright browser tests, 128 synthetic swarm cases, deterministic before/after audio benchmark matrices

defects.repro: Requires clear walk-through script so judges without physical microphones can experience the identical workflow
defects.proposed_fix: Provide quiet text mode and pre-recorded synthetic demo walkthrough in submission package

missing_evidence: Confirmed hackathon extension deadline from organizer official email/announcement channel (assumes Nov 1 submission cutoff)
one_reason_to_reject: Targeting a specialized neurodivergent demographic rather than broad general consumer voice assistant
one_compelling_reason_to_award: A complete, truthful, production-grade application that showcases AssemblyAI TTS and Voice Agent capabilities at the highest standard of engineering
